Product Description

Locs Men's Gangster Oversized Rectangular Horn Rim Sunglasses – 91055 Series. The 91055 is the ultimate "power frame" in the Locs catalog, featuring an oversized horn-rimmed rectangular profile that commands attention. Designed for those who want maximum presence and a classic "OG" look, these sunglasses offer a wider fit and a bold, thick-frame aesthetic. Available in the iconic All-Black or high-visibility Mirror and Revo lenses, the 91055 series is built with impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses and UV400 protection. Whether you're on the street or behind the wheel, these shades provide the dark privacy and hardcore style that Locs is legendary for.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sunglasses to be good quality and value for money, with a comfortable fit that works well for big heads. The lenses are dark enough for sun protection, and customers like the appearance, with one highlighting the purple, blue, and green mirrored lenses as their favorite. The size receives mixed feedback - while some find them perfectly oversized, others say they're too big. The durability is concerning, with multiple customers reporting that the frames snapped after a few weeks of use.

5 out of 5 stars
Locs for the Locas
I was looking for some shades and came across some good ol Locs. I pretty surprised about the $7.50 price! So I certainly couldn’t pass them up! The darkness is great. The size is perfect. They look good. They’re an any occasion shade. They’re comfortable as well. I love they block the sun really well. They don’t distort vision like some shades do. I just love them. They stay in my car and get put on as soon as I get in and the tunes turn on. The only complaint I have is one of the gold pieces came out but it was easy to pop back in. They look good in everything. Keeping old school in some Locs black shades.
